goal: Restore the complete unchanged welcome for each sent bare Studio invocation instead of a mode-only reply.
authorization: Owner reported the recurring mode-only startup failure and requested enforcement of the existing protected welcome contract; standing paired-update authorization applies.
observed_failure: Owner reports a reply containing only the intent selection, without the full capability introduction.
diagnosis: Source has the full asset and instructions, but the bootstrap requires a separate asset read and a later instruction emphasizes a short choice. The actual host retrieval trace is unavailable; this is a bounded diagnosis, not a proven runtime cause.

allowed_sections.orchestrator: Invocation trigger description, immediate full-response projection, removal of mode-only ambiguity; existing craft routes preserved.
allowed_sections.startup_reference: Canonical asset and synchronized excerpt relationship only; menu text and transitions unchanged.
allowed_sections.validator_and_tests: Full welcome integrity, excerpt equality/placement and rejection of supplied truncated replies; no claimed host interception.
allowed_sections.release_metadata: Version markers and one factual release note.

exclusions: canonical welcome wording or layout changes
acceptance_criteria: Full welcome present at the start of the entry owner and exactly equal to its source
Mode-only and shortened supplied replies fail exact response checks
GitHub and existing saved plugin are read back from the same package
evidence_boundary: Owner report, source checks and supplied-response checks are distinct from active-client behavior; active-client verification remains NOT_RUN unless actually observed.
rollback: Selective revert of this startup patch and version dependencies; preserve later edits and existing package identity.
